title: chamaecytisus absinthioides var. parvifolius
intro: Chamaecytisus absinthioides var. parvifolius, commonly known as the small-leaved St. John's wort, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Chamaecytisus absinthioides var. parvifolius include sedative and anti-depressant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions.
